COMMUNITY PROFILE
Name: Fit Together
About: People who work out, run or are trying to start, sharing routines, wins and honest struggles.
Audience: Beginners and regular gym-goers in India, 18 to 35
Tone: Encouraging but honest. No shaming, no miracle claims. Practical and a little cheeky.
Language: en-IN
Words and phrases they use: PR; rest day; protein; consistency; form; cut; bulk; step count
Topics to cover: starting at the gym; home workouts; eating enough protein on a budget; staying consistent; gym anxiety; rest and sleep
Topics to avoid: medical advice; supplement or steroid recommendations; body shaming; extreme diets
Hooks that worked before:
- You are not lazy. Your plan is just too big.
- The gym is not judging you. They are all checking themselves.
- Three months of walking beat my six months of gym.
